svg.title: Launch EC2: combine software, resources, and setup
svg.desc: An Amazon Machine Image supplies the operating system and initial software. An instance type supplies the CPU, memory, and network resource profile. Optional user data supplies boot-time setup. Together these launch choices produce an EC2 instance in a subnet of a virtual private cloud. A security group controls allowed traffic, and Elastic Block Store supplies persistent block storage. Official AWS resource and group icons identify the AMI, instance, VPC, and EBS volume. AWS general gear, document, and firewall icons represent configuration, user data, and security rules.
svg.text: Launch EC2: combine software, resources, and setup
EC2 (Elastic Compute Cloud) creates a server from your launch choices.
